aboutSubheading: Your trusted local cabinet makers in Melbourne's South Eastern Suburbs
aboutText: CabNetWorks has been designing and building premium custom cabinetry for homes across Melbourne's South Eastern Suburbs for over 15 years. Our small, dedicated team of skilled tradespeople takes pride in every cut, joint and finish — delivering kitchens, vanities, laundry cabinets and entertainment units that are built to last. We work closely with each client from concept to completion, ensuring every project reflects your personal style and the way you actually use your space.

servicesSubheading: Expertly crafted cabinetry solutions for every room in your home
servicesText: At CabNetWorks, we specialise in designing, building and installing custom cabinetry tailored to your exact specifications. Whether you're renovating your kitchen, updating your bathroom or need a clever storage solution for your laundry, we've got you covered.

services.title: Custom Kitchen Cabinets
services.desc: Bespoke kitchen cabinetry designed around your layout, storage needs and personal taste. From modern handleless designs to classic shaker styles — built to last with premium hardware and finishes.

services.title: Custom Cabinets
services.desc: General-purpose custom cabinetry for studies, hallways, mudrooms and more. We design and build storage solutions that maximise every inch of your space.

services.title: Custom Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Beautiful floating and floor-standing vanities crafted from moisture-resistant materials. Designed to complement your tiles, tapware and overall bathroom aesthetic.

services.title: Custom Laundry Cabinets
services.desc: Smart laundry cabinetry with dedicated spaces for appliances, cleaning supplies and folding. Turn your laundry into a functional, organised room you actually enjoy using.

services.title: TV & Entertainment Wall Units
services.desc: Statement entertainment cabinetry that hides cables, displays your media and becomes the centrepiece of your living room. Custom designed for your TV size and equipment.

services.title: Custom Wardrobes & Pantries
services.desc: Built-in wardrobes and walk-in pantry fit-outs with adjustable shelving, soft-close drawers and clever organisers. Tailored storage that keeps everything in its place.

testimonialsSubheading: Real feedback from homeowners across Melbourne's South Eastern Suburbs

testimonials.text: CabNetWorks did an absolutely brilliant job on our new kitchen. The attention to detail was incredible — every drawer slides perfectly, the soft-close hinges are top quality, and the finish is immaculate. They worked around our renovation timeline and kept the site tidy the whole way through. Couldn't be happier with the result.
testimonials.name: Dave Thompson

testimonials.text: We had CabNetWorks build a custom entertainment unit and a set of laundry cabinets. From the first consultation to the final install, they were professional, on time and genuinely easy to deal with. The entertainment unit fits our space perfectly and all the cables are hidden — exactly what we wanted. Highly recommend.
testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell

testimonials.text: After getting three quotes for our bathroom vanity, CabNetWorks stood out because they actually listened to what we wanted. The vanity they built is stunning — solid construction, beautiful timber finish, and it was installed without a single hitch. Great value for the quality of workmanship you get.
testimonials.name: Michael Russo
